<thought>We need the target molecule SMILES to build the root node. The target is the product of template 20810 applied to the two precursors given in apply_template-1. To obtain the product SMILES, we retrieve the template details (including the mapped reaction) for template 20810 using the get_template tool, then extract the product side of the mapped reaction. This will give us the target SMILES needed for the route JSON.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{"template_id":"20810"}</action_input>
